items.headline: Alibaba releases Qwen3 model family
items.summary: Qwen3 is an Apache 2.0 open-weight family of two MoE models (235B-A22B, 30B-A3B) and six dense models (0.6B–32B) with switchable thinking and non-thinking modes, trained on about 36 trillion tokens covering 119 languages and dialects. Qwen claims the flagship is competitive with DeepSeek-R1, o1, o3-mini, Grok-3 and Gemini 2.5 Pro.
